audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Professional male narration dominates the center-mix with a clear, broadcast-ready tone and moderate speech rate. Background music consists of a synthesized pop/electronic track with a steady 4/4 beat. Ambient noise is absent, replaced by studio-clean silence. (2) A transient digital UI sound effect (a sharp 'tick') signals a menu interaction. The narrator’s voice rises in pitch and arousal as he describes the conflict. The electronic BGM remains steady with a synth-bass pulse. (3) A high-frequency 'ping' sound effect marks a specific game notification. The narration speed increases slightly to convey excitement. The BGM maintains its tempo, providing a rhythmic bed for the speech. (4) A cartoon-style impact sound effect (a soft 'thud') emphasizes a comedic moment. The narrator uses an exaggerated, sarcastic tone. The acoustic texture remains bright with high spectral centroid weight from the electronic elements. (5) Final phase includes a slight change in vocal inflection to a friendlier, call-to-action style. The BGM begins a slight fade-out toward the end. No other incidental noises are present besides the vocal and music layers.
